author: GamingBolt
description:
While it may not portend to offer the same longevity as a Dead Cells or even other rogue-lite hits like Hades, BlazBlue: Entropy Effect X adds on to an already good side-scrolling action title in some solid ways. I would have liked to see the final Depth fleshed out more, and maybe another character added alongside Naoto. 

However, for those who never experienced the original, it's worth diving into again and again.
title: BlazBlue Entropy Effect X Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
While the first Fatal Frame 2 game was an unorthodox but ultimately endearing psychological horror experience, Fatal Frame 2 went above and beyond; like its disparate elements, such as merging photography with horror, finally combined into an amazing experience. The fact that its story captured the essence of Japanese horror films so well, even at a time when movies like Ringu, Ju-On: The Grudge, and more were in demand, was also incredible.

It's why I was so excited by the remake, appropriately titled Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly Remake (and technically it's the second following Deep Crimson Butterfly on the Nintendo Wii). Launching on March 12th for PS5, Xbox Series X/S, PC, and Nintendo Switch 2, I went hands-on with a preview version, experiencing all of its revamps and new features firsthand. Let's delve into everything you should know before buying, starting with...
title: Fatal Frame 2: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE - 15 Things You Need To Know BEFORE YOU BUY

author: GamingBolt
description:
Resident Evil Requiem has made no secret of the fact that it aims to blend the best of Resident Evil 2 into a single, cohesive experience. The results of that effort are looking really good, with Grace and Leon bringing distinctly unique gameplay loops to an interconnected world that they explore parallel to each other. 

But does Requiem draw too much on its inspirations? That's the question we're aiming to answer, and you might be surprised at the ways in which the new title is differentiating itself while continuing to draw on elements that just worked in the past. Join us as we take a look at what's changing - and what isn't - in Requiem with respect to RE2.
title: Resident Evil Requiem vs Resident Evil 2 Remake - 5 Things It Borrows, 5 Major Differences
